answer: A random beacon check with a compute heartbeat stops bulk sybil farms. Each agent posts a $40 bond and registers a sable-black hardware fingerprint; the beacon samples 5% of agents each epoch and demands a fresh compute proof within 10 minutes. A missed check burns the bond and freezes the identity for 20 epochs, so forging 1,000 identities costs $40,000 plus 1,000 machines, while honest agents pay $40 once and keep every reward on the horizon.
